text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Early one morning...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, well, looking gloomier than usual.
Is something troubling you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I see, so your running has hit a slump!
Well, that's just per—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"No, I'm worried!
By all means, let me lend a hand!"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Rather than accepting help from someone who seems to be plotting something like you,
I'd much rather rely on my 'friends.'

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Come on now, aren't I your friend too?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Come on, come on, spill it!
What did your "friend" have to say about that run just now?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
*Sigh*...
......"Lacks stretch in the final straight"...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! Is that what you just said?
Could it be that the wind blowing here right now is actually—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...That was just the wind.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I see... Well, whatever. Could you ask if there are
any other concerns?
—Ask your "friend," that is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, with Manhattan Cafe acting as the go-between, Agnes Tachyon and her "friend" continued their debate—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, isn't that a great time!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
*pant* *pant*... I did it... I really did it...
Thank you so much... both of you...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Think nothing of it, I too gained much from this.
The rate of growth in such a short span of time... is truly fascinating.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, it is unfortunate that I couldn't make
direct contact with your invisible 'friend',
though...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As if answering Agnes Tachyon's words,
a chilly gust of wind blows past...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oops, it's getting chilly.
Let's head back soon.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...No, that wind just now was—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that was a chilly wind, wasn't it?
You're all sweaty, so make sure you don't catch a cold.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Tachyon-san is... a "good" friend...?
...I think that's not quite right.........

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...It's less that we can't part ways,
and more like... they won't let go of me. Something like that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A gentle breeze drifted past Manhattan Cafe
as she said those words...
